race.comment: PLUCKY ENUFF (5) has been strong late in her two runs to date, the latest seven days ago when fifth over today's distance at Pakenham. Draws a decent gate for the first time which will make life a lot easier. Just gets the nod in a competitive maiden. SOPHIA'S LEGACY (9) found the line well and wasn't beaten far on debut over this course and distance eight days ago. Can improve enough to play a significant role. SYMPHONY SISTA (7) got going late to grab second on debut over 1300m at this track recently. Can race closer from a better draw today and the extra 100m is a positive. VANARA PRINCESS (10) has only raced twice and should appreciate getting out over a bit more ground this time. CATCH A PRINCESS (1) is also in the mix first-up from a spell.
